title: China's super-rich 'in shock' and hunting for cash as Beijing issues surprise tax on offshore trusts
summary_full: Beijing's move to tax offshore trusts, long used by China's ultra-rich to hold money, has set off a rush to lawyers and a scramble for cash.
summary_public: Beijing's move to tax offshore trusts, long used by China's ultra-rich to hold money, has set off a rush to lawyers and a scramble for cash.
